tasks.title: Setup Project Repository and Base Architecture
tasks.description: Initialize the project repository with React.js frontend and Node.js/Express backend structure. Set up MongoDB connection and basic project configuration.
tasks.details: Create a new GitHub repository. Initialize frontend with React.js 18+ using Create React App or Vite. Set up backend with Node.js 18+ and Express 4+. Configure MongoDB 5+ connection using Mongoose. Set up Docker configuration for development. Implement basic folder structure following best practices. Configure ESLint and Prettier for code quality. Set up basic CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify successful project initialization by running the application locally. Test MongoDB connection. Ensure Docker containers build and run correctly. Validate that CI/CD pipeline executes successfully on push.

subtasks.title: Create GitHub Repository and Project Structure
subtasks.description: Initialize the GitHub repository and establish the basic project structure for a full-stack application
subtasks.details:
1. Create a new GitHub repository with an appropriate name
2. Initialize with README.md, .gitignore (Node.js template), and LICENSE files
3. Create the root project structure with folders: `/frontend`, `/backend`, `/docs`
4. Add a root package.json for workspace management
5. Create initial documentation explaining the project architecture
6. Test by cloning the repository and verifying the structure is intact

subtasks.title: Setup React.js Frontend Environment
subtasks.description: Initialize and configure the React.js frontend application with necessary dependencies and configuration
subtasks.details:
1. Navigate to the `/frontend` directory
2. Initialize React application using Vite with TypeScript template
3. Configure folder structure: `/src/components`, `/src/pages`, `/src/hooks`, `/src/utils`, `/src/assets`
4. Set up ESLint and Prettier configuration for React
5. Add `.env` file with example environment variables
6. Configure package.json scripts for development, building, and testing
7. Test by running the development server and verifying the app loads correctly

subtasks.title: Setup Node.js/Express Backend Structure
subtasks.description: Initialize and configure the Node.js/Express backend with appropriate folder structure and basic endpoints
subtasks.details:
1. Navigate to the `/backend` directory
2. Initialize Node.js project with `npm init`
3. Install Express.js, cors, dotenv, and other essential dependencies
4. Create folder structure: `/src/controllers`, `/src/models`, `/src/routes`, `/src/middleware`, `/src/config`, `/src/utils`
5. Implement basic server.js file with Express configuration
6. Set up a health check endpoint (`GET /api/health`)
7. Configure ESLint and Prettier for Node.js
8. Test by starting the server and verifying the health endpoint responds correctly

subtasks.title: Configure MongoDB Connection with Mongoose
subtasks.description: Set up MongoDB connection using Mongoose and implement database configuration
subtasks.details:
1. Install Mongoose in the backend
2. Create database configuration in `/backend/src/config/db.js`
3. Implement connection function with error handling and reconnection logic
4. Add MongoDB connection string to `.env` file
5. Create a sample schema and model in `/backend/src/models`
6. Update server.js to connect to MongoDB on startup
7. Test by verifying successful database connection in logs and ability to perform basic operations on the sample model

subtasks.title: Implement Docker Configuration for Development
subtasks.description: Create Docker and Docker Compose configuration for local development environment
subtasks.details:
1. Create Dockerfile for frontend in `/frontend/Dockerfile`
2. Create Dockerfile for backend in `/backend/Dockerfile`
3. Create docker-compose.yml in the root directory
4. Configure services for frontend, backend, and MongoDB
5. Set up volume mappings for hot reloading
6. Configure environment variables and networking between containers
7. Add docker-related entries to .gitignore
8. Test by running `docker-compose up` and verifying all services start correctly and can communicate with each other

subtasks.title: Set up CI/CD Pipeline with GitHub Actions
subtasks.description: Implement continuous integration and deployment workflow using GitHub Actions
subtasks.details:
1. Create `.github/workflows` directory in the repository
2. Implement `ci.yml` workflow for continuous integration
3. Configure steps for linting, testing, and building both frontend and backend
4. Implement caching for node_modules to speed up workflow
5. Add status badges to README.md
6. Configure branch protection rules in GitHub repository settings
7. Test by pushing changes and verifying the workflow runs successfully
8. Optionally, add a deployment workflow for staging/production environments

tasks.title: Implement User Authentication System
tasks.description: Develop the authentication system with user registration, login, and JWT-based authentication with role-based access control.
tasks.details: Implement the User data model in MongoDB as specified in the PRD. Create authentication API endpoints (/api/auth/register, /api/auth/login, /api/auth/logout, /api/auth/me). Implement JWT authentication with refresh tokens. Use bcrypt for secure password hashing. Set up role-based access control (parent, child). Create frontend authentication forms and protected routes. Implement token storage and refresh mechanism in the frontend.
tasks.testStrategy: Test user registration with valid and invalid data. Verify login functionality and JWT token generation. Test token refresh mechanism. Validate role-based access restrictions. Ensure password reset functionality works correctly. Test authentication persistence across page reloads.

subtasks.title: Create User Data Model in MongoDB
subtasks.description: Implement the User schema and model in MongoDB with all required fields for authentication and role-based access control.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Define User schema with fields: email, password (hashed), firstName, lastName, role (enum: 'parent', 'child'), refreshToken, createdAt, updatedAt
2. Add validation for email uniqueness and required fields
3. Create indexes for frequently queried fields
4. Implement pre-save hooks for password hashing using bcrypt
5. Add methods for password comparison
6. Create model relationships if needed (e.g., parent-child relationships)
7. Test the model by creating sample users and validating schema constraints

subtasks.title: Implement Password Security with Bcrypt
subtasks.description: Set up secure password handling using bcrypt for hashing and verification.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Install bcrypt package
2. Create utility functions for password hashing with appropriate salt rounds
3. Implement password verification function to compare plain text with hashed passwords
4. Add password strength validation middleware
5. Ensure password is never returned in API responses
6. Test hashing and verification functions with various password inputs
7. Document security practices implemented for the team

subtasks.title: Create Authentication API Endpoints
subtasks.description: Develop the core authentication API endpoints for registration, login, logout, and retrieving user information.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create route handlers for /api/auth/register, /api/auth/login, /api/auth/logout, and /api/auth/me
2. Implement input validation using a validation library
3. Set up error handling for authentication failures
4. Create controller functions for each endpoint
5. Implement user registration logic with duplicate checking
6. Develop login logic with credential verification
7. Create logout functionality to invalidate tokens
8. Implement the /me endpoint to return current user data
9. Test all endpoints using Postman or similar tool

subtasks.title: Implement JWT Authentication with Refresh Tokens
subtasks.description: Set up JWT token generation, validation, and refresh token mechanism for maintaining user sessions.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Install required JWT packages
2. Create utility functions for generating access tokens with appropriate expiration
3. Implement refresh token generation and storage in the user document
4. Create middleware to verify JWT tokens on protected routes
5. Implement token refresh endpoint (/api/auth/refresh)
6. Set up secure cookie handling for tokens
7. Create token blacklisting mechanism for logout
8. Test token generation, validation, and refresh flows
9. Implement proper error handling for token expiration and invalid tokens

subtasks.title: Implement Role-Based Access Control
subtasks.description: Set up role-based permissions system to control access based on user roles (parent, child).
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create middleware for role-based route protection
2. Define permission constants for different user roles
3. Implement role checking in protected routes
4. Create utility functions to verify permissions for specific actions
5. Add role information to JWT payload
6. Set up route-specific permission checks
7. Test access control by attempting operations with different user roles
8. Document the permission system for other developers

subtasks.title: Create Frontend Authentication Forms and Protected Routes
subtasks.description: Develop the frontend components for user registration, login, and implement protected route navigation.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create registration form component with validation
2. Implement login form with error handling
3. Develop form submission handlers to connect with API endpoints
4. Create protected route component/wrapper
5. Implement authentication context/provider to manage auth state
6. Add navigation guards based on authentication status
7. Create user profile view component
8. Implement logout functionality in the UI
9. Test form validation and submission
10. Ensure responsive design for all authentication forms

subtasks.title: Implement Frontend Token Management
subtasks.description: Set up client-side token storage, automatic token refresh, and authentication state management.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create utility functions for secure token storage (HTTP-only cookies or localStorage with security considerations)
2. Implement authentication state management using context/redux
3. Set up axios interceptors for adding auth headers to requests
4. Create automatic token refresh mechanism before expiration
5. Implement handling for authentication errors (401/403)
6. Add automatic logout on authentication failures
7. Create persistent login functionality using refresh tokens
8. Test token refresh flows and authentication persistence
9. Implement proper cleanup on logout
10. Document the token management approach for the team

tasks.title: Develop Family Management System
tasks.description: Create the family creation, invitation, and management functionality to allow parents to create family groups and add members.
tasks.details: Implement the Family data model in MongoDB as specified in the PRD. Create Family API endpoints (/api/families, /api/families/:id, etc.). Develop family creation flow for parent users. Implement member invitation system via email. Create frontend components for family management. Develop UI for viewing family members and their roles. Implement avatar and profile customization for family members.
tasks.testStrategy: Test family creation with various inputs. Verify email invitation system works correctly. Test joining a family with an invitation. Validate family member listing and role display. Ensure profile customization saves and displays correctly.

subtasks.title: Create Family Data Model in MongoDB
subtasks.description: Implement the Family schema and model in MongoDB as specified in the PRD.
subtasks.details:
1. Define Family schema with fields for name, members array, pendingInvitations, createdBy, and timestamps
2. Implement member sub-schema with user reference, role, and joinedAt
3. Create pendingInvitation sub-schema with email, role, token, and expiresAt
4. Add validation for required fields
5. Create indexes for efficient querying
6. Add methods for common operations (check membership, handle invitations, etc.)
7. Test the model by creating sample families and validating schema constraints

subtasks.title: Implement Family API Endpoints
subtasks.description: Create RESTful API endpoints for family management, including creation, retrieval, and member management.
subtasks.details:
1. Create route handlers for /api/families (GET, POST), /api/families/:id (GET)
2. Implement endpoints for member management: /api/families/:id/invite (POST), /api/families/:id/members/:userId (DELETE)
3. Create controller functions for each endpoint
4. Implement input validation
5. Set up proper authentication and authorization checks
6. Create invitation acceptance endpoint with token validation
7. Test all endpoints using Postman or similar tool

subtasks.title: Create Email Invitation System
subtasks.description: Implement the system for sending email invitations to family members.
subtasks.details:
1. Set up email sending service integration (Nodemailer, SendGrid, etc.)
2. Create email templates for family invitations
3. Implement token generation for secure invitations
4. Create utility functions for sending invitation emails
5. Add token validation and expiration logic
6. Implement error handling for email sending failures
7. Test email delivery and token validation

subtasks.title: Develop Frontend Family Creation Flow
subtasks.description: Create the frontend interfaces for parents to create new family groups.
subtasks.details:
1. Design and implement family creation form component
2. Add input validation for family name and other fields
3. Create API integration for submitting family creation requests
4. Implement success and error handling
5. Add navigation to family management after creation
6. Test form validation and submission

subtasks.title: Implement Family Member Management UI
subtasks.description: Create frontend components for viewing and managing family members.
subtasks.details:
1. Design and implement family members list component
2. Create member invitation form component
3. Implement member role display and management
4. Add member removal functionality with confirmation
5. Create components for pending invitations management
6. Implement invitation acceptance workflow
7. Test all member management operations

subtasks.title: Create Family Dashboard Component
subtasks.description: Develop a dashboard view for family information and activities.
subtasks.details:
1. Design family dashboard layout
2. Implement family information display (name, creation date, member count)
3. Create recent activity component for family events
4. Add task summary section showing family tasks
5. Implement navigation to detailed task and member views
6. Test dashboard rendering and data integration

subtasks.title: Implement Member Profile Customization
subtasks.description: Create functionality for family members to customize their profiles.
subtasks.details:
1. Extend user model with profile customization fields
2. Design and implement profile editing component
3. Add avatar selection or upload functionality
4. Implement display name and preference settings
5. Create API endpoints for saving profile changes
6. Add validation for profile data
7. Test profile customization functionality

tasks.title: Implement Core Task Management
tasks.description: Develop the core task creation, assignment, and management functionality that forms the foundation of the application.
tasks.details: Implement the Task data model in MongoDB as specified in the PRD. Create Task API endpoints (/api/tasks, /api/tasks/:id, etc.). Develop task creation interface with fields for title, description, due date, and assignees. Implement task assignment to family members. Create task listing and basic filtering functionality. Develop task completion marking functionality. Implement basic task categorization (homework, chores, activities).
tasks.testStrategy: Test task creation with various inputs. Verify task assignment to multiple family members. Test task listing and filtering by different criteria. Validate task completion marking functionality. Ensure task categories are correctly applied and filtered.

subtasks.title: Implement Task Data Model in MongoDB
subtasks.description: Create the MongoDB schema for tasks according to the PRD specifications
subtasks.details: Create a Task schema in Mongoose with fields for title (String, required), description (String), dueDate (Date), status (String, enum: ['pending', 'in-progress', 'completed']), assignees (Array of ObjectIds referencing User model), category (String, enum: ['homework', 'chores', 'activities', 'other']), createdBy (ObjectId referencing User model), and timestamps. Add appropriate validation for required fields. Test the model by creating sample tasks and verifying data integrity.

subtasks.title: Develop Task API Endpoints
subtasks.description: Create RESTful API endpoints for task CRUD operations
subtasks.details: Implement the following API endpoints: GET /api/tasks (list all tasks with filtering options), POST /api/tasks (create new task), GET /api/tasks/:id (get task details), PUT /api/tasks/:id (update task), DELETE /api/tasks/:id (delete task), PATCH /api/tasks/:id/status (update task status). Include proper validation middleware for request bodies. Implement authentication middleware to ensure users can only access tasks they have permission for. Write unit tests for each endpoint using Jest to verify correct behavior for valid and invalid requests.

subtasks.title: Create Task Creation Interface
subtasks.description: Develop the UI for creating new tasks with all required fields
subtasks.details: Build a form component with fields for title (text input, required), description (textarea), due date (date picker), category (dropdown with options: homework, chores, activities, other). Implement form validation to ensure required fields are completed. Add a submit button that calls the POST /api/tasks API endpoint. Include error handling to display validation errors from the API. Style the form according to the application's design system. Test the form by creating tasks and verifying they appear in the database.

subtasks.title: Implement Task Assignment Functionality
subtasks.description: Create the mechanism to assign tasks to family members
subtasks.details: Add a multi-select component to the task creation/edit form that displays all family members. Implement the backend logic to associate selected users with the task in the assignees field. Create an API endpoint for reassigning tasks (PATCH /api/tasks/:id/assignees). Add permissions checking to ensure only authorized users (parents or task creators) can assign tasks. Develop UI components to display assigned users on task cards/details. Test assignment functionality by creating tasks with different assignees and verifying correct assignment.

subtasks.title: Develop Task Listing and Filtering
subtasks.description: Create views to display tasks with filtering capabilities
subtasks.details: Implement a task list component that displays tasks in a card or list format. Show key information for each task: title, due date, status, category, and assignees. Add filtering controls for status, category, assignee, and due date range. Implement sorting options (by due date, creation date, status). Create a search function to filter tasks by title or description. Ensure the list updates dynamically when filters change. Add pagination if the number of tasks is large. Test filtering by creating various tasks and verifying filter results match expected criteria.

subtasks.title: Implement Task Completion Functionality
subtasks.description: Create the mechanism to mark tasks as completed
subtasks.details: Add a status toggle button/checkbox on task cards and detail view. Implement the frontend logic to call the PATCH /api/tasks/:id/status endpoint when status changes. Create visual indicators for different task statuses (color coding, icons). Add confirmation dialog for completing tasks. Implement optional completion notes field. Add validation to prevent reopening tasks if configured that way in settings. Test completion functionality by changing task statuses and verifying the changes persist and display correctly.

subtasks.title: Implement Task Categorization System
subtasks.description: Develop the system for categorizing tasks into different types
subtasks.details: Enhance the task model to support the required categories (homework, chores, activities). Add category selection in task creation/edit forms with appropriate icons for each category. Implement category-specific validation rules if needed (e.g., homework might require a subject field). Create category-based views in the task listing interface. Add visual indicators for different categories (icons, colors). Implement category statistics (count of tasks by category). Test categorization by creating tasks in different categories and verifying they appear in the correct filtered views.

tasks.title: Develop Task Dashboard and UI Components
tasks.description: Create the main dashboard interface and core UI components for task visualization and management.
tasks.details: Design and implement responsive dashboard layout using Material UI or Tailwind CSS. Create task cards with visual indicators for priority and status. Implement filtering and sorting controls for tasks. Develop user-specific dashboards showing assigned tasks. Create visual hierarchy for important information (due dates, priorities). Implement color coding for different family members. Ensure accessibility with readable fonts, sufficient contrast, and screen reader support.
tasks.testStrategy: Test dashboard rendering on various screen sizes. Verify task cards display all relevant information correctly. Test filtering and sorting functionality. Validate color coding and visual indicators. Ensure accessibility compliance using automated tools and manual testing.

subtasks.title: Create responsive dashboard layout structure
subtasks.description: Design and implement the core responsive layout for the task dashboard using either Material UI or Tailwind CSS, establishing the foundation for all other components.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Set up the basic project structure with the chosen UI framework (Material UI or Tailwind CSS)
2. Create a responsive grid layout that adapts to different screen sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop)
3. Implement the main navigation components (sidebar, header, content area)
4. Design the dashboard sections (task overview, upcoming tasks, recent activities)
5. Create placeholder containers for task cards and filtering controls
6. Implement responsive breakpoints for different device sizes
7. Set up theme configuration for consistent styling across components

Testing approach:
- Verify layout responsiveness across different screen sizes
- Ensure proper grid alignment and spacing
- Test navigation components functionality
- Validate theme consistency

subtasks.title: Develop task card components with visual indicators
subtasks.description: Create reusable task card components that display task information with visual indicators for priority, status, and other key attributes.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Design the task card component with fields for title, description, due date, assignee, priority, and status
2. Implement visual indicators for task priority (color coding, icons)
3. Create status badges/indicators (pending, in progress, completed)
4. Add hover and interaction states for cards
5. Implement expandable/collapsible functionality for detailed task information
6. Create skeleton loading states for task cards
7. Design empty states for when no tasks are available

Testing approach:
- Test rendering of task cards with different data combinations
- Verify visual indicators correctly reflect task attributes
- Test interaction states (hover, click, expand/collapse)
- Validate proper handling of long text content
- Ensure accessibility of all interactive elements

subtasks.title: Implement filtering and sorting controls
subtasks.description: Create UI controls for filtering and sorting tasks based on various criteria such as status, priority, due date, and assignee.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Design filter control components (dropdowns, checkboxes, toggle buttons)
2. Implement filter logic for status, priority, due date, and assignee
3. Create sorting controls for different task attributes
4. Develop search functionality for finding specific tasks
5. Implement filter combination logic (applying multiple filters)
6. Add clear/reset filters option
7. Create visual indicators for active filters
8. Ensure filter state persistence during navigation

Testing approach:
- Test each filter control individually and in combination
- Verify sorting functionality for different attributes
- Test search functionality with various queries
- Validate filter state persistence
- Ensure proper handling of edge cases (no results, invalid filters)

subtasks.title: Create user-specific dashboard views
subtasks.description: Develop personalized dashboard views that display tasks assigned to specific family members, with appropriate visual differentiation.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create user selection/switching mechanism
2. Implement user-specific task filtering logic
3. Design user avatars and identification system
4. Develop color coding scheme for different family members
5. Create user-specific summary statistics (tasks completed, pending, etc.)
6. Implement user preference saving (view preferences, filters)
7. Design user-specific empty states and onboarding

Testing approach:
- Test user switching functionality
- Verify correct filtering of tasks by user
- Validate color coding consistency
- Test user preference saving and loading
- Ensure proper statistics calculation for each user

subtasks.title: Implement accessibility features and visual hierarchy
subtasks.description: Enhance the dashboard with proper accessibility features and establish a clear visual hierarchy for important information.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Audit and implement proper semantic HTML throughout the dashboard
2. Ensure sufficient color contrast for all text and UI elements
3. Add proper ARIA attributes for interactive components
4. Implement keyboard navigation support
5. Create focus states for interactive elements
6. Establish visual hierarchy through typography, spacing, and color
7. Implement screen reader support with descriptive text
8. Add tooltips and helper text for complex UI elements
9. Test with accessibility tools and make necessary adjustments

Testing approach:
- Run automated accessibility audits (Lighthouse, axe)
- Test keyboard navigation throughout the application
- Verify screen reader functionality
- Check color contrast ratios for all text elements
- Conduct usability testing with focus on information hierarchy

tasks.title: Implement Basic Calendar View
tasks.description: Create a calendar view that displays tasks by date and allows for basic interaction with scheduled tasks.
tasks.details: Implement calendar component with day, week, and month views. Develop functionality to display tasks on their due dates. Create color-coding system to differentiate tasks by family member. Implement task detail popup when clicking on calendar items. Add filtering capabilities by family member or category. Ensure responsive design for calendar on all device sizes.
tasks.testStrategy: Test calendar rendering in different view modes (day, week, month). Verify tasks appear on correct dates. Test color-coding accuracy. Validate task detail popup functionality. Test calendar responsiveness on various screen sizes. Ensure filtering works correctly.

subtasks.title: Create base calendar component with multiple views
subtasks.description: Implement the foundational calendar component with day, week, and month view options
subtasks.details: Build a reusable calendar component that can toggle between day, week, and month views. Use a calendar library like FullCalendar or react-big-calendar as a foundation. Implement view switching controls and ensure proper date navigation (prev/next/today). Set up the basic grid structure for each view type and handle date calculations. Ensure the component accepts a date range and can render empty calendar cells appropriately.

subtasks.title: Implement task display on calendar
subtasks.description: Develop functionality to display tasks on their scheduled dates across all calendar views
subtasks.details: Extend the calendar component to accept task data and display tasks on their due dates. Create visual representations for tasks that fit within the calendar cells. Handle edge cases like multiple tasks on the same day/time and tasks that span multiple days. Implement proper truncation for long task names and ensure tasks are positioned correctly in each view (day, week, month). Add visual indicators for task status (completed, in progress, etc.).

subtasks.title: Implement color-coding system for family members
subtasks.description: Create a color-coding system to visually differentiate tasks by family member
subtasks.details: Design a color palette that assigns distinct colors to each family member. Modify the task display to incorporate these colors (either as borders, backgrounds, or indicators). Create a legend component that shows which color corresponds to which family member. Ensure colors have sufficient contrast and are accessible. Store color preferences in the application state and allow for consistent color usage across the application.

subtasks.title: Create task detail popup functionality
subtasks.description: Implement an interactive popup that shows task details when clicking on calendar items
subtasks.details: Create a modal or popup component that appears when a user clicks on a task in the calendar. Display comprehensive task information including title, description, assigned family member, due date/time, category, and status. Add action buttons for common operations (edit, delete, mark complete). Position the popup appropriately relative to the clicked task and implement proper focus management for accessibility. Include close functionality and ensure the popup works across all calendar views.

subtasks.title: Add filtering and responsive design
subtasks.description: Implement filtering capabilities and ensure responsive calendar design across all device sizes
subtasks.details: Create filter controls that allow users to show/hide tasks by family member or category. Implement the filtering logic to update the calendar display based on selected filters. Ensure filter state persists during navigation. For responsive design, adapt the calendar layout for different screen sizes (possibly showing fewer days on smaller screens). Implement touch-friendly interactions for mobile devices. Test thoroughly across various device sizes and ensure the calendar remains usable and visually coherent at all breakpoints.

tasks.title: Develop Notification System
tasks.description: Implement the notification system for alerting users about new tasks, upcoming deadlines, and task completions.
tasks.details: Implement the Notification data model in MongoDB as specified in the PRD. Create Notification API endpoints (/api/notifications, etc.). Develop in-app notification center UI. Implement notification generation for key events (new task, task completion, upcoming deadline). Integrate with SendGrid or similar service for email notifications. Create notification preference settings for users. Implement notification read/unread status tracking.
tasks.testStrategy: Test notification generation for various events. Verify notification display in the UI. Test email notification delivery. Validate notification preference settings. Ensure notification read/unread status updates correctly. Test notification clearing and bulk actions.

subtasks.title: Create Notification Data Model in MongoDB
subtasks.description: Design and implement the Notification schema in MongoDB to store notification data according to the PRD specifications.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create a Notification schema with fields for: id, userId, type (task_created, deadline_approaching, task_completed), content, relatedEntityId (taskId), isRead, createdAt, and expiresAt.
2. Add appropriate indexes for efficient querying (userId, isRead, createdAt).
3. Implement validation rules for the schema fields.
4. Create model methods for common operations (markAsRead, deleteNotification).
5. Write unit tests to verify schema validation and model methods.
6. Document the schema design and API for other developers.

subtasks.title: Implement Notification API Endpoints
subtasks.description: Create RESTful API endpoints for managing notifications, including retrieving, marking as read, and deleting notifications.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create the following API endpoints:
   - GET /api/notifications - List all notifications for the current user with pagination
   - GET /api/notifications/unread - Get count of unread notifications
   - PUT /api/notifications/:id/read - Mark a notification as read
   - PUT /api/notifications/read-all - Mark all notifications as read
   - DELETE /api/notifications/:id - Delete a notification
2. Implement proper authentication middleware to ensure users can only access their own notifications.
3. Add request validation using a library like Joi or express-validator.
4. Implement pagination for notification listing with limit and offset parameters.
5. Write integration tests for each endpoint using Jest or similar testing framework.
6. Document the API endpoints using Swagger or similar tool.

subtasks.title: Develop In-App Notification Center UI
subtasks.description: Create the user interface components for displaying and interacting with notifications within the application.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create a NotificationCenter component that displays a notification icon with an unread count badge in the app header.
2. Implement a dropdown panel that shows recent notifications when clicked.
3. Design notification list items with different styling based on notification type and read status.
4. Add actions for marking notifications as read when clicked and clearing all notifications.
5. Implement infinite scroll or pagination for loading more notifications.
6. Add animations for new notifications appearing.
7. Create skeleton loaders for notification items during loading states.
8. Ensure the UI is responsive and works well on mobile devices.
9. Write unit tests for the notification components using React Testing Library or similar.
10. Implement accessibility features (ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation).

subtasks.title: Implement Notification Generation Logic
subtasks.description: Create the business logic for generating notifications based on key events in the application.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create a NotificationService class to handle notification generation.
2. Implement event listeners for key application events:
   - Task creation: Generate notification for assigned users
   - Task completion: Notify task creator and relevant stakeholders
   - Upcoming deadlines: Create notifications for tasks due within 24 hours and 3 days
3. Design a queuing system for processing notifications asynchronously using a library like Bull or similar.
4. Implement notification deduplication logic to prevent notification spam.
5. Add configurable throttling for notification frequency.
6. Create unit tests for the notification generation logic, mocking the event triggers.
7. Implement logging for notification generation for debugging purposes.

subtasks.title: Integrate Email Notification Service
subtasks.description: Integrate with SendGrid or similar email service to send email notifications for important events.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Set up SendGrid (or alternative) account and obtain API keys.
2. Create an EmailService class to handle email sending with appropriate error handling and retries.
3. Design email templates for different notification types (new task, deadline reminder, task completion).
4. Implement logic to determine which notifications should trigger emails based on user preferences.
5. Create a queue for processing email notifications to handle high volume scenarios.
6. Add rate limiting to prevent email flooding.
7. Implement email tracking to record when emails are sent, opened, and clicked.
8. Set up email delivery failure handling and reporting.
9. Create unit tests with mocked SendGrid API responses.
10. Document the email integration for other developers.

subtasks.title: Implement User Notification Preferences
subtasks.description: Create settings that allow users to configure which notifications they receive and how they receive them.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Extend the User model with notification preference fields:
   - In-app notification settings (task_created, deadline_approaching, task_completed)
   - Email notification settings (same categories)
   - Notification frequency settings (immediate, daily digest, weekly digest)
2. Create API endpoints for updating notification preferences:
   - GET /api/users/notification-preferences
   - PUT /api/users/notification-preferences
3. Develop a NotificationPreferences UI component with toggles for different notification types and channels.
4. Modify the notification generation logic to respect user preferences.
5. Implement a notification digest system for users who prefer batched notifications.
6. Add a preview feature to show examples of different notification types.
7. Create unit and integration tests for the preference system.
8. Ensure all notification generation respects the user's current preferences.

tasks.title: Implement Advanced Task Features
tasks.description: Enhance the task management system with advanced features like recurring tasks, priorities, and attachments.
tasks.details: Implement recurring task functionality with customizable patterns. Develop task priority system (high, medium, low) with visual indicators. Create task commenting system for family communication. Implement file attachment capability for tasks (using AWS S3 or similar). Develop task history tracking to show changes and updates. Enhance filtering and sorting options for tasks. Implement task dependency relationships if needed.
tasks.testStrategy: Test recurring task creation with various patterns. Verify task priority assignment and display. Test commenting functionality on tasks. Validate file upload and attachment to tasks. Ensure task history correctly tracks changes. Test enhanced filtering and sorting options.

subtasks.title: Implement Task Priority System
subtasks.description: Develop a priority system for tasks with high, medium, and low levels, including database schema updates, UI components, and visual indicators.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Update the task database schema to include a 'priority' field (enum with values: 'high', 'medium', 'low', default to 'medium')
2. Create UI components for priority selection in task creation/edit forms
3. Implement visual indicators for different priorities (e.g., color coding: red for high, yellow for medium, green for low)
4. Add priority information to task list views and detail views
5. Update task API endpoints to handle priority data
6. Implement priority-based sorting functionality

Testing approach:
- Unit tests for priority-related database operations
- UI tests for priority selection and display
- Integration tests for priority filtering and sorting

subtasks.title: Implement Recurring Task Functionality
subtasks.description: Create a system for recurring tasks with customizable patterns like daily, weekly, monthly, or custom intervals.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Extend the task schema to include recurrence fields (frequency type, interval, end date/count)
2. Design and implement UI for setting up recurring task patterns
3. Create a background job/scheduler to generate new task instances based on recurrence patterns
4. Implement logic to handle task completion vs. recurrence pattern (mark instance complete while maintaining pattern)
5. Add ability to edit recurrence patterns or cancel future occurrences
6. Implement visual indicators for recurring tasks

Testing approach:
- Unit tests for recurrence pattern logic
- Integration tests for task generation
- Time-based tests to verify correct scheduling
- UI tests for recurrence setup and management

subtasks.title: Implement Task Commenting System
subtasks.description: Develop a commenting system for tasks to enable family communication and discussion about specific tasks.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Create a comments database schema with relationships to tasks and users
2. Implement API endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting comments
3. Design and implement UI components for displaying comments in task details view
4. Add comment creation form with text input and submission
5. Implement real-time or polling updates for new comments
6. Add notification system for new comments on tasks

Testing approach:
- Unit tests for comment CRUD operations
- Integration tests for comment-task relationships
- UI tests for comment display and creation
- Performance tests for comment loading with large numbers of comments

subtasks.title: Implement File Attachment Capability
subtasks.description: Create functionality to attach files to tasks using AWS S3 or similar cloud storage.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Set up AWS S3 bucket or similar cloud storage solution
2. Create database schema for file attachments (filename, file type, size, S3 URL, task relationship)
3. Implement secure file upload functionality with proper authentication
4. Create API endpoints for uploading, downloading, and deleting attachments
5. Implement UI components for file upload, display, and management
6. Add file type validation and size limitations
7. Implement progress indicators for file uploads

Testing approach:
- Unit tests for file metadata handling
- Integration tests with mock S3 service
- UI tests for upload and download functionality
- Security tests for access control to attachments

subtasks.title: Implement Task History Tracking
subtasks.description: Develop a system to track and display the history of changes and updates made to tasks.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Create a task history database schema to store change records
2. Implement logic to capture changes to task properties (status, priority, due date, etc.)
3. Record user information and timestamps with each change
4. Design and implement UI to display task history in chronological order
5. Add filtering options for history entries by change type
6. Implement condensed vs. detailed history views

Testing approach:
- Unit tests for history record creation
- Integration tests for change tracking across task operations
- UI tests for history display
- Performance tests with large history datasets

subtasks.title: Enhance Filtering and Sorting Options
subtasks.description: Expand the task filtering and sorting capabilities to include the new advanced features.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Update existing filter system to include new properties (priority, recurrence, has attachments, has comments)
2. Implement advanced search functionality across task properties and comments
3. Create UI components for advanced filtering options
4. Add sorting options by priority, comment count, attachment count, and last update
5. Implement filter presets/saved filters functionality
6. Add visual indicators for active filters

Testing approach:
- Unit tests for filter and sort logic
- Integration tests for combined filters
- UI tests for filter controls
- Performance tests with large datasets and complex filters

subtasks.title: Implement Task Dependency Relationships
subtasks.description: Create a system to establish and manage dependencies between tasks, where one task must be completed before another can start.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Update task schema to include dependency relationships (many-to-many)
2. Implement API endpoints for creating and managing task dependencies
3. Create UI for adding, viewing, and removing dependencies between tasks
4. Implement validation to prevent circular dependencies
5. Add visual indicators for dependent tasks and blockers
6. Update task status logic to consider dependencies (can't start if blockers exist)
7. Implement dependency chain visualization

Testing approach:
- Unit tests for dependency relationship management
- Integration tests for dependency validation
- UI tests for dependency creation and visualization
- Logic tests for circular dependency prevention

tasks.title: Develop Enhanced Calendar Features
tasks.description: Improve the calendar with advanced features like drag-and-drop scheduling and conflict detection.
tasks.details: Implement drag-and-drop functionality for rescheduling tasks. Develop conflict detection for overlapping tasks or busy times. Create visual indicators for task density and potential conflicts. Implement calendar export functionality (iCal, Google Calendar). Add calendar view customization options. Enhance calendar with family event support beyond tasks. Implement calendar sharing options.
tasks.testStrategy: Test drag-and-drop rescheduling of tasks. Verify conflict detection for overlapping tasks. Test calendar export to various formats. Validate custom view options. Ensure family events display correctly. Test calendar sharing functionality.

subtasks.title: Implement drag-and-drop functionality for calendar events
subtasks.description: Create the core drag-and-drop mechanism that allows users to reschedule tasks by dragging them to new time slots on the calendar.
subtasks.details: Use a JavaScript library like interact.js or react-dnd to implement drag-and-drop. Ensure the UI updates in real-time as items are dragged. Implement snap-to-grid functionality for time slots. Update the database when an item is dropped in a new position. Add visual feedback during the drag operation (highlighting valid drop zones, showing the new time as a tooltip).

subtasks.title: Develop conflict detection system for overlapping events
subtasks.description: Create a system that detects when tasks or events overlap with existing calendar items or user-defined busy times.
subtasks.details: Implement an algorithm to check for time conflicts when events are created or moved. Create a data structure to efficiently query for overlapping events. Add validation during drag operations to highlight conflicts in real-time. Develop a notification system to alert users about conflicts. Include options for conflict resolution (reschedule, override, split task).

subtasks.title: Create visual indicators for task density and conflicts
subtasks.description: Design and implement visual cues that show users how busy different time periods are and highlight potential scheduling conflicts.
subtasks.details: Use color gradients to indicate time periods with high task density. Add warning icons or highlights for time slots with conflicts. Implement a heat map view option for month/week views. Create tooltips that show details about busy periods when hovering. Add a density scale/legend to help users interpret the visual indicators.

subtasks.title: Implement calendar export functionality
subtasks.description: Add the ability to export calendar data to standard formats like iCal and Google Calendar.
subtasks.details: Create an iCalendar (.ics) file generator that follows RFC 5545 standards. Implement Google Calendar API integration for direct export. Add export options in the UI (export all, export selected, export date range). Include recurring event support in exports. Add options to customize what data is included in exports (task details, attachments, etc.).

subtasks.title: Add calendar view customization options
subtasks.description: Develop features that allow users to customize how their calendar is displayed, including different views and filtering options.
subtasks.details: Implement multiple calendar views (day, week, month, agenda, timeline). Create filters for event types, priorities, and categories. Add options to customize the time scale (working hours, 24-hour view). Implement color coding for different event types. Add the ability to save view preferences. Create a responsive design that works well on different screen sizes.

subtasks.title: Implement calendar sharing and family event support
subtasks.description: Add functionality to share calendars with family members and support family events beyond individual tasks.
subtasks.details: Create a permission system for shared calendars (view-only, edit, admin). Implement family event types with multiple participant support. Add notification options for shared events. Create a UI for managing shared calendars and invitations. Implement conflict detection across multiple users' calendars. Add synchronization to ensure all users see the latest calendar updates.

tasks.title: Implement Responsive Design and Final Polishing
tasks.description: Ensure the application is fully responsive across all devices and apply final UI/UX improvements before release.
tasks.details: Optimize responsive design for all screen sizes (desktop, tablet, mobile). Implement mobile-specific touch interactions. Conduct comprehensive UI/UX review and refinement. Optimize performance for slower devices and connections. Implement loading states and error handling throughout the application. Add final animations and transitions for improved user experience. Conduct cross-browser testing and fixes. Prepare for Phase 2 features like gamification and rewards.
tasks.testStrategy: Test application on various devices and screen sizes. Verify touch interactions on mobile devices. Measure and optimize performance metrics. Test error scenarios and recovery. Validate loading states and indicators. Ensure cross-browser compatibility. Conduct usability testing with representative users.

subtasks.title: Implement Core Responsive Layout Framework
subtasks.description: Create the foundational responsive grid system and breakpoints that will ensure proper layout across all device sizes
subtasks.details: Define standard breakpoints for mobile (320-480px), tablet (481-768px), laptop (769-1024px), and desktop (1025px+). Implement a flexible grid system using CSS Grid and/or Flexbox. Create responsive container components that adapt to different screen sizes. Ensure all text elements use relative units (rem/em). Test the core layout on sample pages across different viewport sizes.

subtasks.title: Optimize UI Components for Mobile Devices
subtasks.description: Adapt all UI components for touch interfaces and smaller screens, implementing mobile-specific interactions
subtasks.details: Increase touch target sizes to at least 44x44px for all interactive elements. Implement touch-friendly interactions (swipe, pinch-to-zoom where appropriate). Replace hover states with appropriate mobile alternatives. Create collapsible navigation for mobile views. Ensure form inputs are properly sized for touch input. Implement mobile-specific features like pull-to-refresh where applicable. Test all components on actual mobile devices.

subtasks.title: Implement Loading States and Error Handling
subtasks.description: Create consistent loading indicators and error handling patterns throughout the application
subtasks.details: Design and implement skeleton loading states for all data-dependent components. Create standardized error messages and recovery options for network failures, form validation errors, and server errors. Implement retry mechanisms for failed operations. Add offline detection and appropriate messaging. Ensure all async operations have proper loading and error states. Create a global error boundary to catch unexpected errors.

subtasks.title: Optimize Performance for Slower Devices and Connections
subtasks.description: Improve application performance focusing on resource-constrained devices and network conditions
subtasks.details: Implement code splitting to reduce initial bundle size. Optimize and lazy-load images with proper srcset attributes. Add service worker for caching critical assets. Implement resource prioritization. Reduce JavaScript execution time through optimization. Set up performance monitoring. Test on low-end devices and throttled network connections. Aim for Time to Interactive under 5 seconds on 3G connections.

subtasks.title: Add Animations and Transitions
subtasks.description: Implement subtle animations and transitions to enhance user experience while maintaining performance
subtasks.details: Create a library of reusable animations for common interactions (page transitions, button states, etc.). Ensure animations respect user preferences (reduced motion). Implement progressive enhancement so core functionality works without animations. Use hardware-accelerated properties (transform, opacity) for smooth performance. Keep animations under 300ms for perceived responsiveness. Test animation performance on lower-end devices.

subtasks.title: Conduct Cross-Browser Testing and Final UI/UX Review
subtasks.description: Perform comprehensive testing across browsers and devices, and make final UI/UX refinements
subtasks.details: Test on major browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and identify/fix inconsistencies. Conduct usability testing with representative users. Create a UI/UX audit checklist covering accessibility, consistency, and usability. Fix any identified issues. Ensure WCAG 2.1 AA compliance. Document any known issues and workarounds. Prepare a list of Phase 2 enhancements including gamification and rewards features. Get final stakeholder approval on the UI/UX.
